problem_type: Modal title wrapping and first-line alignment
symptom: The English HD confirmation question loses its ending in the 380px card.
direct_cause: The spend title truncates and the custom call name forbids soft wraps.
class_root: The dialog shell owns the name but leaves its wrapping policy to each header.
affected_population: Creators reviewing English or dynamic titles in a narrow dialog
internal_only_reason: The application owns the title contract and utility classes; the installed Mantine ModalBase stylesheet already permits native text wrapping.
invariants: The visible title can wrap in its allocation; controls align with a wrapped title at its top.
A title that fits keeps its existing typography and alignment.

door_reduction.why_not: Each read door represents a separate dialog or lab sample with its own workflow and content. All render the title through DesignModal. The registered owner writes the rule; the custom-call editor and page read the shared name class.

generality_proof: Every audited caller hands the name to Modal.Title. Standard wrapping and the alignment of the header row are decided by the shell; icon slots reuse its row alignment.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own title wrapping and header alignment while preserving caller typography.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The 380px confirmation uses the shell title next to its icon.
CustomCallEditor passes this shared name class to DesignModal.title; the adjacent model label has separate overflow behavior.
The custom gateway h2 belongs to ModelSettingsPageSurface in page mode; the modal presentation passes a string to the shell.

recurrence.reason: Two independent callers imposed a one-line constraint and new callers can pass header classes.
same_class_scan: door-map DesignModal: 19 production files plus one design lab file.
Reviewed classNames.title/header, inline and extracted header callbacks, and the imported CustomCallTitle name class.
Review #1696: function-returned classes, styles.title, and indirect header wrappers can bypass the source scan. Render all 20 callers and inspect the labelled heading and its ancestors.

prevention.invariant: All shell titles wrap and every icon row can use the shell alignment.
prevention.failure_mode: The shell removes title truncation overrides at render time. A caller that wraps the name in a truncating header fails its DOM regression test.
prevention.strategy: Resolve Mantine styling inputs, retain typography, and reserve title wrapping and clipping for DesignModal. Check custom header ancestors after React renders them.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove the title truncate and whitespace-nowrap overrides at their source.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: This repair uses the existing Mantine composition, native wrapping, ResizeObserver and Tailwind utilities.

migration: Only renderer layout changes. Saved projects, settings, confirmation payloads and title strings need no migration.
residual_risks: Desktop sample-mode and platform font comparison are pending coordinator screenshots.
